notes.title: Welcome to the Quest of Dungeloria community page on Steam!
notes.content:
After almost 300 days of intense development and sleepless nights, as the sole developer, I am happy to present my game to the world. Check out the official gameplay trailer:
[previewyoutube=2_0rzuzcdQc;full][/previewyoutube]

Want to join us in the development of the game?

Join our official Twitter page to keep up to date with the latest updates and get a chance to join future closed testing of the project.
